item: The launcher's record-lock takeover never moves a live lock (row 100)
summary: On the mkdir-lock path (no flock: macOS) the takeover of a dead owner's lock moved the lock out and put a live one back, so for an instant two launchers held it and a trim dropped an append (1 of 8 exit rows lost on CI). A taker now marks the lock with a reap mark born with its pid, reads the owner again under it and renames the lock away only if it still names the same dead owner; dead takers' marks are cleared one clearer at a time; a directory mark under the same name serves filesystems without hard links. An eight-taker test on one dead owner fails 3 of 3 on the old launcher, passes 30 of 30 under load. Residuals stated in the code: several crashes inside a few instructions, long-lived pid reuse.
